[[Fonk]] is the child protegé of the [[Hoff]], the master of [[Polymock]]. Fonk is the fourth opponent in the Polymock quest chain.

As part of the Polymock quest chain, he uses the following pieces (in order):
*[[Kappa Polymock Piece]]
*[[Aloe Seed Polymock Piece]]
*[[Wind Rider Polymock Piece]]

In tournament play, he selects from these pieces:
*Common:
**[[Fire Imp Polymock Piece]]
**[[Ice Imp Polymock Piece]]
**[[Mergoyle Polymock Piece]]
*Uncommon:
**[[Aloe Seed Polymock Piece]]
**[[Ice Elemental Polymock Piece]]
**[[Kappa Polymock Piece]]
*Rare:
**[[Gaki Polymock Piece]]
**[[Ruby Djinn Polymock Piece]]
**[[Stone Rain Polymock Piece]]
**[[Wind Rider Polymock Piece]]

==Locations==
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Gunnar's Hold}}
**{{NPC location|Polymock Glacier}} (only when challenged to a Polymock match)

'''Quests involved in:'''

==Dialogue==
Before registering at least 3 Polymock pieces:
:''"You need to acquire your starter Polymock pieces in [[Rata Sum]] before we can play. There is a gate to the [[region]] in the [[Vloxen Excavations]], west of here. When you get there, say hi to [[Hoff]]. He is the master of Polymock."''

After registering at least 3 Polymock pieces, before being defeated:
:''"Aside from the Grand Master himself, I'm the world's greatest Polymock player. I laugh in your face! Ha ha! See? Laughter. Do you dare to challenge me?"''
::'''I wish to play you {{sic}} in a game of Polymock.'''
::''"You will be removed from your party and taken to a Polymock arena to battle Fonk. Do you wish to proceed?"''
:::'''Accept''': ''"Yes."''
:::'''Decline''': ''"No."''

After being defeated:
:''"I told you I was the second greatest player in the world. What I didn't tell you is I am the second greatest *tournament* Polymock player in the world. Surprise, jerkface! Let's play by tournament rules now and you can witness my true skill! You'll need 1 comomn piece, 1 uncommon piece, and 1 rare piece to play. Are you writing this down?"''
::'''I wish to play you {{sic}} in a game of Polymock.'''
::(before registering 1 piece of each type)
::''"You don't have at least 1 common, 1 uncommon, and 1 rare Polymock piece unlocked yet. You cannot play any opponents using tournament rules at this time."''
::(after registering 1 piece of each type)
::''"You will be removed from your party and taken to a Polymock arena to battle Fonk. Do you wish to proceed?"''
:::'''Accept''': ''"Yes."''
:::'''Decline''': ''"No."''

==Quotes==
During a Polymock match:
:''"An interesting choice. I believe it will prove quite disastrous."''
:''"If you're thinking of making a spectacular comeback, think again."''
:''"Oh. That will certainly hurt your chances to win."''
:''"This isn't going how you hoped, is it?"''
:''"Tough loss there.... Actually, easy for me. But for you? Not so much."''
:''"You do realize we are battling to the death, don't you?"''
:''"You, my friend, are on the verge of defeat by me. No real surprise there."''
:''"You think like a Norn. No, that's not a compliment."''

When he loses a Polymock match:
:''"Inconceivable! How could I have lost? Must be those blasted [[Norn]] dulling my keen senses."''

When he wins a Polymock match:
:''"On the whole, that went much as I had expected. I won. You lost. Rematch?"''

==Notes==
*Awards 90 [[Asuran reputation point]]s upon defeat in tournament play.
